title: Pass starts at Outside: every strategy clears in straight lines, not along the stock and the selected edge

labels.name: P1
labels.description: Unsafe or wrong output: gouge, collision, wrong G-code, crash, data loss; blocks a cut

labels.name: source:agent
labels.description: Opened by an AI agent (not a human reporter)

labels.name: effort:max
labels.description: New algorithms, formats or open design (issue-worker-max)

body:
## What happens

With "Pass starts at" Outside, every strategy makes a strange clearing pattern of straight lines.

- The pattern does not follow the shape of the stock edge.
- The pattern does not follow the selected edge.
- The tool lifts more than it must.

The maintainer reported this. He set the priority at `P1`.

## What is expected

- The first passes blend from straight lines into curves. The shape follows the selected edge as the pass gets closer to the part.
- The pass follows the stock edge as long as it stays outside the part.
- The tool stays down when a link is clear. It lifts only where the cut needs it.

## Why it matters

- The path is slow and it is not the shape that the user selects.
- The unnecessary lifts cost time and leave marks.
- On a P1, a wrong path can also cut the stock edge in the wrong place.

## What to check

- The Outside start plan of each strategy: which geometry does it use for the first passes, the stock outline or the part offset?
- The blend from a straight lead to the part offset: where is the ring built, and does it taper the distance to the selected edge?
- The link and lift rule of the first passes: is a lift made although the chord is clear?
- The pins: `pass_start_*`, `offset_pass_start` and the catalog cases may assert the straight-line pattern as correct.

## Related

- #3932 (2D Adaptive trochoidal slots to a wall, no outside start).
- #3933 (2D Pocket offset rings behave like waterline).
- #3928 (2D Offset Outside ramp only with Arc turn corners).

## Missing at filing

- The sketch, the stock, the tool and the posted program for one strategy. Add them as a comment when the case is reproduced.
